messages:
maria-partnerships: FYI Novatech just updated us — there's a customs hold and a manifest mismatch on PO NT-9923. ETA slipped ~8 days. We need to triage Dedicated capacity for EU customers ASAP.

orion-novatech: sorry folks, port congestion + paperwork error on our side. partial release possible but we need to confirm which racks clear today. working with broker now.

raj-procurement: how many racks affected and are these reserved for committed customers or marketplace on-demand? need exact counts to decide buy-from-backup.

maria-partnerships: looks like 12 racks total, 8 are tied to reserved Dedicated commitments (EU-dedicated-01), 4 marketplace. PO snippet:```PO: NT-9923
Qty: 12 racks
SKU: NV-8180
Reserved: 8 (cust IDs: C102, C215, C330...)
Manifest: docs incomplete (missing COO)```

oli-logistics: if we can get a partial release (even 4 racks) we can prioritize 6 for commitments by splitting shipments and cross-docking EU nodes. cross-dock adds ~1 business day but avoids full delay.

claire-ops: Customer impact: two mid-market customers on dedicated have launch windows next week. if we can't cover, we'll need to offer credits or temporary hosted burst. what's fallback inventory right now?

raj-procurement: Backup partner (ByteCloud distro) quoted availability: 4 racks within 5 business days, price diff +12%. I can initiate emergency PO if legal OK.

sarah-legal: emergency PO fine but we need to preserve NDA/redistribution terms with Novatech. also check if marketplace orders need separate contract amendments.

orion-novatech: confirm: we can clear 3 racks today, additional 3 by tomorrow noon if broker gets original COO. we'll send scanned docs by 11:30 PT.

maria-partnerships: thanks. action plan proposal: (1) Orion to confirm docs and partial release by 11:30 PT (2) Raj to create emergency PO for 4 racks from ByteCloud if partial <6 (3) Oli to prepare cross-dock routing for any partial delivery (4) Claire to draft customer comms with options (credit/hosted burst)

notify-bot: NOTE: New manifest update received from novatech at 11:12 AM — docs attached to thread.

raj-procurement: I'll start the backup PO but will hold final release until Orion confirms counts. ETA on ByteCloud pick-up is 5 business days — if Novatech delivers 6 by tomorrow we can avoid purchase.

claire-ops: I'll prepare messaging templates. Quick ask: what credit % do we approve for missed launch SLA? proposing 25% for marketplace, 50% for dedicated customers impacted beyond SLA.

sarah-legal: 25%/50% reasonable as a one-off; ops should keep a log to avoid precedent.

oli-logistics: booking tentative customs broker slot for expedited clearance if docs come through — nominal fee estimated. I'll ping once slot confirmed.

maria-partnerships: solid. final ask to Orion — can you confirm the 3+3 split and upload COO by 11:30 PT? we'll freeze backup PO at noon if we see progress.

orion-novatech: will do. apologies again — will upload docs and update manifest within the hour.

maria-partnerships: thanks everyone. I'll update this thread after noon and coordinate the customer comms if we need to go to backup. :pray:
